## 🧭 STRATEGY

9. Trend Confirmation?
CONFIRMED: IWM ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.13% | 1M: +6.35%) and multiple commodity ETFs ABOVE TREND. DIVERGENCE: MAJOR — SPY CORRECTION (1W: -0.35% | 1M: +2.19%), XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) and TLT CORRECTION (1W: -0.15% | 1M: +0.30%) create a transitional market environment.

10. Portfolio Direction?
Favor cyclicals/resources showing strength such as XLE ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.19% | 1M: +9.78%) and SLV ABOVE TREND (1W: +11.94% | 1M: +40.34%); reduce exposure to tech weakness in XLK CORRECTION (1W: -0.36% | 1M: +2.30%) and communication stress in XLC BELOW TREND (1W: -2.32% | 1M: -0.95%). Bonds neutral: LQD CORRECTION (1W: -0.06% | 1M: +0.41%).

12. Commodities to Watch?

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 6/11 sectors positive, mixed ETF signals across equities, credit and volatility. Cyclicals and precious metals showing strength (XLE ABOVE TREND; SLV ABOVE TREND), while tech and communications are showing weakness (XLK CORRECTION; XLC BELOW TREND) — watch the SPY/XLK/TLT divergence for next directional resolve.
